Michael Jackson and Madonna were the King and Queen of Pop, but behind their legendary careers was a complicated relationship of admiration, rivalry, romance, creative conflict and eventual regret.

In this complete documentary, we explore the extraordinary history between Michael Jackson and Madonna, from Madonna's early admiration for Michael during the Thriller era to her emergence as one of his greatest commercial rivals and their surprising private relationship in the early 1990s.

While Michael was recording in 1991, he approached Madonna about a potential collaboration. The two began spending time together privately, appeared at The Ivy in Los Angeles and famously attended the 1991 Academy Awards together. From Thriller and Like a Virgin to Bad, Like a Prayer, Dangerous and the 1991 Oscars, this is the complete story of two radically different artists who helped redefine modern superstardom and the unusual relationship that developed between the King and Queen of Pop.
